title: stellaria arvensis
intro: Stellaria arvensis, commonly known as Starweed or Rough Chickweed, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Caryophyllaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Stellaria arvensis include its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
